rows.name: KTX Seoul Station → Busan Station
rows.address: Seoul Station (Line 1/4, AREX) → Busan Station (Busan Metro Line 1)
rows.hours: Frequent daily departures from early morning
rows.price: ₩54,400 standard one-way (post Sep 1, 2026 integrated KTX fare; was ₩59,800)
rows.notes: Fastest trains ≈2h15-2h17; typical stopping trains 2h40-3h00 — the itinerary's 2h45 fits. Since Sep 1, 2026, KTX & SRT are merged under Korail (SRT renamed 'KTX-Sancheon'), fares cut ~10% and bookings unified. Reserve via letskorail.com / Korail Talk app. Arriving 30-45 min early is sensible for a first-time KTX ride. Full transport details on the Transport page.
rows.transit: From the hotel: Line 4 from Myeongdong → Seoul Station (1 stop).

sources.label: SBS News — KTX integration & fare cut (Seoul-Busan ₩54,400)

rows.name: Busan Station → Haeundae
rows.address: Busan Metro Line 1 (Busan Station) → transfer at Seomyeon → Line 2 → Haeundae Station
rows.price: ≈₩1,800 with transportation card (Seoul T-money accepted in Busan)
rows.notes: ≈40-55 min door to door. Taxi alternative ≈30-40 min, ₩15,000-25,000. Busan Metro is run by Busan Transportation Corporation — humetro.busan.kr for maps and station info.
rows.transit: Follow '도시철도/Busan Metro' signs from the KTX concourse to the connected Line 1 platform.

sources.label: Busan Transportation Corporation (official Busan Metro operator)

rows.name: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE — check-in
rows.address: 55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan — one block from Haeundae Beach, near Haeundae Station (Line 2) Exit 5 area
rows.notes: Opened 2024; 383-385 rooms; rooftop infinity pool (19F, seasonal package rules); phone +82-51-771-1000. Official hotel site was unreachable during verification — details verified via major booking platforms (consistent) and flagged. Drop bags before 15:00 if arriving early.
rows.transit: Haeundae Station (Line 2), then a short walk to the beach block.

rows.name: Haeundae Beach
rows.hours: Public beach — accessible year-round; the officially-operated summer season (June 26 - Aug 2026) ran 09:00-18:00 with lifeguards; November is off-season with free open access
rows.notes: Busan's most famous beach, a short walk from the hotel and Haeundae Market. Off-season strolling is the norm in November; Dongbaek Island coastal trail (wolbae) is nearby. Adjacent tourist info center at 264 Haeundaehaebyeon-ro.

sources.label: Busan Metropolitan City (official) — Haeundae beach season notice

rows.name: Haeundae Market (traditional market)
rows.hours: 09:00-22:00 (varies by stall; most food stalls in full swing from late afternoon)
rows.notes: Hours match the itinerary. Street food (tteokbokki, hotteok, grilled seafood, kalguksu) near Haeundae Beach — roughly 5 min from the sand and ~10 min from the L7. Open year-round (individual stall closures vary).
